jobs.question: What are the ids and names of the battles that led to more than 10 people killed in total.

agent.final_sql:
SELECT b.id, b.name
FROM battle b
JOIN ship s ON s.lost_in_battle = b.id
JOIN death d ON d.caused_by_ship_id = s.id
GROUP BY b.id, b.name
HAVING SUM(d.killed) > 10
ORDER BY b.id
